I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.
Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.

translations.web: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
translations.bsb: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
translations.kjv: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
translations.asv: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah In the land of the living.
